title: Takbo Para sa Kalikasan 2026 Review: Manila's Environmental 'Air' Run
seo_title: Takbo Para sa Kalikasan 2026 Review | Manila Philippines
meta_description: Takbo Para sa Kalikasan 2026 (Air): September 20 in Ermita, Manila. Green Media Events' environmental-themed road race for clean air.
dek: Set for 20 September 2026 in Ermita, Manila, this Green Media Events production is themed 'Air' — an environmental advocacy run in the Philippine capital.
verdict: Takbo Para sa Kalikasan (Run for Nature) 2026 carries the 'Air' theme — an environmental-advocacy road race in Ermita, Manila, organised by Green Media Events. The environmental theme gives the race genuine purpose beyond the finish line, likely with tree-planting components, eco-friendly race kits, and air-quality awareness messaging. September in Manila is the tail of the wet season. For runners wanting a Manila race with environmental advocacy and community purpose, this is a meaningful pick.
